description: Source code for GPIO driver for PCAL64XXA I2C GPIO expanders in Zephyr RTOS, including register definitions, driver data structures, initialization, and configuration functions.

methods.name: pcal64xxa_pin_configure
methods.description: Configures a GPIO pin with specified flags, updates internal pin configuration, and applies it via chip API.

methods.name: pcal64xxa_process_input
methods.description: Reads input port state, updates last known state, and fires callbacks if triggers are detected.

methods.name: pcal64xxa_work_handler
methods.description: Work handler that processes input port changes.

methods.name: pcal64xxa_int_gpio_handler
methods.description: GPIO interrupt callback that submits work to process input changes.

methods.name: pcal64xxa_port_get_raw
methods.description: Reads raw port value, also clears interrupt.

methods.name: pcal64xxa_port_set_raw
methods.description: Sets raw port value with mask, toggle, and value.

methods.name: pcal64xxa_port_set_masked_raw
methods.description: Sets port bits specified by mask.

methods.name: pcal64xxa_pin_interrupt_configure
methods.description: Configures interrupt mode and trigger for a pin.

methods.name: pcal64xxa_i2c_write
methods.description: Writes a byte to a specified register over I2C.

methods.name: pcal64xxa_i2c_read
methods.description: Reads a byte from a specified register over I2C.

methods.name: pcal64xxa_init
methods.description: Initializes the PCAL64XXA device, configures reset, input, and interrupt lines, and sets initial state.
